allowed_changes: monthly review on first execution session
use T-1 and earlier Nasdaq CNY closes only
compute trailing peak over exactly 252 sessions including T-1
hold 100% gold when T-1 Nasdaq drawdown from that peak is <= -20%; otherwise 100% Nasdaq
fixed annual 50/50 Nasdaq-gold barbell and cash controls
expected_outputs: owner-by-month, trades, cash, gross and fingerprint
follow_up_policy: After formal results, no drawdown threshold, lookback, hysteresis, asset, cadence, weight, fee or confirmation-filter rescue is permitted in this lineage.
forbidden_changes: separate entry and recovery hysteresis thresholds
adding momentum, volatility, VIX, NFCI, curve or macro filters
changing Nasdaq/gold owners or blending weights
shorting, leverage, financing, gross >100% or negative cash
hypothesis: A 20% decline from a trailing one-year high is a conventional bear-market state rather than a tuned forecast threshold. Remaining fully exposed to Nasdaq outside that state and rotating to gold only once the T-1 Nasdaq close is at least 20% below its trailing 252-session closing high may retain most secular growth while limiting the deeper second half of major equity bear markets.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
selection_metric: One canonical 20% bear-state threshold and one trailing 252-session high only. No threshold/lookback search. Validation, objective and barbell comparison are separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.
strategy_lineage: bear-state-001 / Nasdaq经典熊市回撤状态001; loss-state rotation between Nasdaq and gold
validation_gates: execution-stress evidence deferred and explicitly warned
